messages:
nina: deploy-bot put the promo on hold for canary B, failing artifact integrity check during promote :rotating_light:
ryan: ugh, link?
nina: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/6412/builds/10234 — promote step hit `checksum-mismatch` when pulling image layers
oli: i've seen this when S3 multipart etags don't match after retry finalizes, could be a finalize race or proxy resume bug
tanvi: logs: ```WARN: layer fetch manifest-sha256:aa11...: expected sha256:aa11b7 got sha256:aa11c8 (etag mismatch)```
deploybot: [bot] promote_attempt(2026-03-21T16:12Z) failed: artifact_integrity_check failed for redwood/worker:canary -> layer checksum mismatch
ryan: is this CI producing corrupt tars or a registry replication issue?
oli: quick triage: CI uploaded artifact X successfully, registry attempted to consolidate multipart parts and a resume retry produced different combined etag. indexer then returned a manifest referencing the new etag but blob readers got older part set — race
tanvi: can we abort the promo and roll back to previous canary tag? or pin to previous sha?
nina: options: 1) pin to last-known-good sha and re-run canary, 2) abort promo and revert canaries to yesterday's release, 3) manual re-upload of layers and flush registry index (needs infra window)
ops-oncall: prefer option 1 to minimize customer impact during change window. infra can investigate post-promo
ryan: agree. pin + re-run makes sense. who owns the pin?
tanvi: i'll pin `worker:canary` -> `sha256:aa11b7` and re-trigger canary smoke. will slack when done
ina: include release-notes note: "promo paused; pinned to last-good image due to layer checksum mismatch. Investigating registry multipart finalize race."
oli: also suggest a guard in deploy-bot to block promotes when any layer checksum mismatch occurs (fail-fast instead of partial promote)
deploybot: [bot] manual_pin applied by tanvi: redwood/worker:canary -> sha256:aa11b7; new canary run queued https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/6412/builds/10236
(12m later)
tanvi: canary smoke green on pinned image, payments and job-worker e2e OK
ryan: staging promote ready with small ramp, rollback window 45m if anything flaps
ops-oncall: infra will open ticket INF-REG-88 to track multipart finalize retries and registry proxy resume behavior
nina: added release note line and notified PM/comms @product @sw-comm
oli: will follow up with build-system on uploader idempotency and multipart assemble checksums
nina: closing thread when prod ramp finishes. thanks all :white_check_mark:
